{{Quote|The Empire that Senior Captain Thrawn is carving into the evil that pervades our worlds is not the Empire you chose to leave. His is an Empire of justice and dignity for all beings. His Empire is one we gladly serve. One we are willing to die for.|Vaantaar|<ref name="COC" />}}
'''Vaantaar''' was the leader of a group of [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], who had escaped from their [[Troukree homeworld|homeworld]], when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had been threatened by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s troops before [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Vaantaar had become connected with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and settled on [[Poln Major]] with his group, where he could act as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of Thrawn. In the [[Whitestone City]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Poln Major, Vaantaar met a group of five renegade [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] known as the [[Hand of Judgment]], who helped to solve a trade dispute between Vaantaar's Troukree and a group of [[Pineath]].<ref name="COC" />

When Esva's troops attacked [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], placed the man under Hand of Judgment's protection in [[Whistling Wind]] tapcafe, the stormtroopers asked Vaantaar to bring them reinforcements. Vaantaar and four of his companions joined the stormtroopers in Governor's [[Battle for Poln Major|defense]], loosing [[Unidentified Troukree (sacrifice)|one]] of their number in the fight. After Esva's group had been beaten back by the stormtroopers, and another Troukree team, who had arrived to act as back-up outside the tapcafe, Vaantaar confronted the Hand of Judgment informing them that his master wanted to meet the renegades and that he was willing to use violence if necessary. Vaantaar brought his prisoners aboard Thrawn's command vessel, ''[[Admonitor]]'', where he helped the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to persuade the stormtroopers to join Thrawn.<ref name="COC" />
